name: REALEC_GED_binary_error-benchmark
description: A binary grammatical/error detection benchmark derived from the REALEC dataset that tests whether a given text segment contains an error. It is framed as a binary classification task (error vs. no error) and is intended to evaluate models' error-detection capability on the target language corpus.
reputation: A focused HuggingFace-hosted benchmark for error detection with modest community visibility, mainly used by researchers working on grammatical error detection.
